leads.reason: Nearly all posts are call-group entry/multiple shills with the contract address. Two posts compare $Rex and $Gekko and mention GeckoTerminal, and the on-chain description says CoinGecko mascot, but no post explains a story or origin; the coin may be tied to CoinGecko's mascot but nothing here confirms it.

Posts are mostly call-group and CTO-radar bot posts; one unverified account claims IGN said the in-game currency is BUCKz (GTA link) and others fight over the OG vs copycat ticker. Thin and unconfirmed.

Only the project's own account (AgentidRent) describes an agent-wallet rental product; every other post is a call-group, scanner or bot alert. No independent coverage, and three same-ticker Solana pools look like copycats.

Search returned one post, about the USAR stock (a rare-earth company near lows), not about the pump.fun USAR coins whose descriptions pitch a national reserve idea; no post links the coins to a story.
Posts are call-group multiples, CA shills and bot scanner alerts for several copycat $GTAVI tickers; the only story post (Rockstar site, June) predates these pools by months.
